list.title: h3
list.match: open call|call for proposals|request for proposals|applications? (?:are |is )?(?:now )?open|accepting (?:applications|proposals)|apply (?:now|by)|\brfp\b

collect_note: Reads the Rockefeller Foundation home page twice a day and keeps any feature block that announces an open call for proposals or applications (today Cities Deliver, AI for city services, Round 1 due 2026-11-29); the deadline is read from the call page. Rockefeller is invite-only for ordinary grants, so its open calls are one-offs and are announced on the home page first.

sample.title: Cities Deliver: A $50 Million Commitment to Better Public Services

Checked 2026-11-12.
